# Coordinates schemas
{: .no_toc}

Coordinate systems describe where a procedure, an experimental interface or a piece of equipment is placed. Each system is a schema; the record stores the system code and the values in the frame it defines.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## How to use this family

- [`equipment`](/api/modules/equipment/): set `coordinates_system` to a type code below and send its properties in `coordinates_details`.
- [`experimentalinterface`](/api/modules/experimentalinterface/): set `coordinates` to a type code below and send its properties in `coordinates_json`.
- [`experimentalinterfacetemplate`](/api/modules/experimentalinterfacetemplate/): set `coordinates` to a type code below and send its properties in `coordinates_json`.
- [`procedure`](/api/modules/procedure/): set `coordinates_system` to a type code below and send its properties in `coordinates_details`.
- [`proceduretemplate`](/api/modules/proceduretemplate/): set `coordinates_system` to a type code below and send its properties in `coordinates_details`.
- Every version is published at `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Coordinates/<Type>/<version>.json` and never changes; `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Coordinates/<Type>.json` is the current version and `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Coordinates/<Type>/` lists the versions. See [Public schemas](/api/public-schemas/).
- Quantities are objects `{"value": <number>, "unit": "<code>"}`. Property paths with `[]` are inside a repeatable list of rows. The server sets the schema version field itself.

## External coordinates

### External XYZ Coordinates with Euler Orientation

- type code `External_XYZ_Euler` · version 2.0.0 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Coordinates/External_XYZ_Euler/2.0.0.json)

Position in a declared external reference frame, such as a rig or stage frame, whose origin, axes, handedness and unrotated pose are defined in the record, with orientation as fixed-frame X, Y then Z rotations. Use it when no anatomical or atlas frame applies.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `referenceFrameName` | Reference frame name | text | yes |  | Short name identifying the external coordinate frame used for this point. |
| `referenceFrameDescription` | Reference frame description | text (multi-line) | yes |  | Define the frame origin, +X/+Y/+Z directions, handedness, and unrotated object pose. |
| `x` | X coordinate | quantity with unit |  | units `nm`, `µm`, `mm`, `m`; default `{"unit": "m"}` | Physical X position in the declared external reference frame. |
| `xAngle` | X angle | quantity with unit |  | units `°`; default `{"unit": "°"}` | First fixed-frame X rotation; positive is counter-clockwise viewed from +X toward origin. |
| `y` | Y coordinate | quantity with unit |  | units `nm`, `µm`, `mm`, `m`; default `{"unit": "m"}` | Physical Y position in the declared external reference frame. |
| `yAngle` | Y angle | quantity with unit |  | units `°`; default `{"unit": "°"}` | Second fixed-frame Y rotation after X; positive is counter-clockwise viewed from +Y toward origin. |
| `z` | Z coordinate | quantity with unit |  | units `nm`, `µm`, `mm`, `m`; default `{"unit": "m"}` | Physical Z position in the declared external reference frame. |
| `zAngle` | Z angle | quantity with unit |  | units `°`; default `{"unit": "°"}` | Third fixed-frame Z rotation after X then Y; positive is counter-clockwise viewed from +Z toward origin. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "referenceFrameName": "text",
    "referenceFrameDescription": "text",
    "x": {
        "value": 1,
        "unit": "m"
    },
    "xAngle": {
        "value": 1,
        "unit": "°"
    }
}
```


### External XYZ Coordinates with Quaternion Orientation

- type code `External_XYZ_Quaternion` · version 1.0.0 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Coordinates/External_XYZ_Quaternion/1.0.0.json)

Physical position and device orientation in a declared external reference frame. Quaternion values use the canonical Hamilton convention and rotate the declared device-local zero pose into the external frame.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `referenceFrameName` | Reference frame name | text | yes |  | Short name identifying the external coordinate frame used for this pose. |
| `referenceFrameDescription` | Reference frame description | text (multi-line) | yes |  | Define the origin, +X/+Y/+Z directions, handedness, and device-local zero pose. |
| `x` | X coordinate | quantity with unit |  | units `nm`, `µm`, `mm`, `m`; default `{"unit": "m"}` | Physical X position in the declared external reference frame. |
| `y` | Y coordinate | quantity with unit |  | units `nm`, `µm`, `mm`, `m`; default `{"unit": "m"}` | Physical Y position in the declared external reference frame. |
| `z` | Z coordinate | quantity with unit |  | units `nm`, `µm`, `mm`, `m`; default `{"unit": "m"}` | Physical Z position in the declared external reference frame. |
| `quaternionW` | Quaternion W | number | yes | ≥ -1 and ≤ 1 | Scalar W component of the canonical unit Hamilton quaternion. |
| `quaternionX` | Quaternion X | number | yes | ≥ -1 and ≤ 1 | X vector component of the canonical unit Hamilton quaternion. |
| `quaternionY` | Quaternion Y | number | yes | ≥ -1 and ≤ 1 | Y vector component of the canonical unit Hamilton quaternion. |
| `quaternionZ` | Quaternion Z | number | yes | ≥ -1 and ≤ 1 | Z vector component of the canonical unit Hamilton quaternion. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "referenceFrameName": "text",
    "referenceFrameDescription": "text",
    "quaternionW": 1.0,
    "quaternionX": 1.0,
    "quaternionY": 1.0,
    "quaternionZ": 1.0,
    "x": {
        "value": 1,
        "unit": "m"
    },
    "y": {
        "value": 1,
        "unit": "m"
    }
}
```


## Stereotaxic coordinates

### Stereotaxic Bregma-Based Absolute Coordinates

- type code `Stereotaxic_BregmaAbsolute` · version 2.0.0 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Coordinates/Stereotaxic_BregmaAbsolute/2.0.0.json)

Absolute AP/ML/DV position measured from Bregma, with +AP anterior, +ML anatomical right and +DV ventral, plus AP and ML tilts and an axial rotation. Use it when DV is given from Bregma rather than as depth from the brain surface.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `apCoordinate` | AP coordinate | quantity with unit |  | units `nm`, `µm`, `mm`, `m`; default `{"unit": "mm"}` | Signed AP position of the absolute point from Bregma; positive is anterior. |
| `apAngle` | AP angle | quantity with unit |  | units `°`; default `{"unit": "°"}` | First rotation: sagittal tilt from vertical around the ML axis; positive tilts anteriorly. |
| `mlCoordinate` | ML coordinate | quantity with unit |  | units `nm`, `µm`, `mm`, `m`; default `{"unit": "mm"}` | Signed ML position of the absolute point from Bregma; positive is anatomical right. |
| `mlAngle` | ML angle | quantity with unit |  | units `°`; default `{"unit": "°"}` | Second rotation: coronal tilt from vertical around the AP axis, after the AP tilt; positive tilts to anatomical right. |
| `dvCoordinate` | DV coordinate | quantity with unit |  | units `nm`, `µm`, `mm`, `m`; default `{"unit": "mm"}` | Signed DV position of the absolute point from Bregma; positive is ventral. |
| `rotation` | Rotation | quantity with unit |  | units `°`; default `{"unit": "°"}` | Clockwise rotation around the object's depth axis when viewed from above; 0° aligns the major feature defined for the selected anchor type with the coronal plane. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "apCoordinate": {
        "value": 1,
        "unit": "mm"
    },
    "apAngle": {
        "value": 1,
        "unit": "°"
    }
}
```

## Landmark-referenced coordinates

### Landmark-Referenced AP/ML/DV Absolute Coordinates

- type code `Landmark_APMLDV_Absolute` · version 1.0.0 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Coordinates/Landmark_APMLDV_Absolute/1.0.0.json)

Absolute AP/ML/DV position from a declared landmark that defines the zeros and axes, with +AP anterior, +ML right and +DV ventral, plus tilts and an axial rotation. Use it for landmarks other than Bregma and Lambda, such as the obex or a cranial window center.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `landmarkReference` | Landmark reference | choice |  | one of `obex`, `interaural_zero`, `anterior_commissure`, `midcommissural_point`, `cranial_window_center`, `surface_landmark`, `custom`, `other` | Landmark defining complete AP, ML, and DV zeros and axes for the absolute frame. |
| `landmarkDescription` | Landmark description | text |  |  | Concise definition of the identity, 3-D origin, and AP/ML/DV axes of a surface, custom, or other landmark. |
| `apCoordinate` | AP coordinate | quantity with unit |  | units `nm`, `µm`, `mm`, `m`; default `{"unit": "mm"}` | AP position of the absolute point from the frame origin; positive is anterior. |
| `mlCoordinate` | ML coordinate | quantity with unit |  | units `nm`, `µm`, `mm`, `m`; default `{"unit": "mm"}` | ML position of the absolute point from the frame origin; positive is anatomical right. |
| `dvCoordinate` | DV coordinate | quantity with unit |  | units `nm`, `µm`, `mm`, `m`; default `{"unit": "mm"}` | DV position of the absolute point from the frame origin; positive is ventral. |
| `apAngle` | AP angle | quantity with unit |  | units `°`; default `{"unit": "°"}` | First rotation: sagittal tilt from vertical around the ML axis; positive tilts anteriorly. |
| `mlAngle` | ML angle | quantity with unit |  | units `°`; default `{"unit": "°"}` | Second rotation: coronal tilt from vertical around the AP axis, after the AP tilt; positive tilts to anatomical right. |
| `rotation` | Rotation | quantity with unit |  | units `°`; default `{"unit": "°"}` | Clockwise rotation around the object's depth axis when viewed from above; 0° aligns the major feature defined for the selected anchor type with the coronal plane. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "landmarkReference": "obex",
    "landmarkDescription": "text"
}
```


### Landmark-Referenced AP/ML Surface Coordinates with Depth

- type code `Landmark_APML_SurfaceDepth` · version 1.0.0 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Coordinates/Landmark_APML_SurfaceDepth/1.0.0.json)

Insertion point given as AP/ML from a declared landmark (+AP anterior, +ML anatomical right) plus a non-negative insertion depth along the final approach axis from a declared surface. Use it for landmark-referenced insertions where depth is measured from the contacted surface.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `landmarkReference` | Landmark reference | choice |  | one of `obex`, `interaural_zero`, `anterior_commissure`, `midcommissural_point`, `cranial_window_center`, `surface_landmark`, `custom`, `other` | Landmark defining AP and ML zeros and axes for the insertion-point frame. |
| `landmarkDescription` | Landmark description | text |  |  | Concise definition of the identity, origin, and AP/ML axes of a surface, custom, or other landmark. |
| `surfaceReference` | Insertion-depth reference surface | choice |  | one of `skull_surface`, `dura_surface`, `pia_surface`, `brain_surface`, `brainstem_surface`, `cord_surface`, `custom` | Physical interface at the insertion point from which insertion depth begins. |
| `surfaceReferenceDescription` | Surface reference description | text |  |  | Concise physical definition of the custom surface used as insertion-depth zero. |
| `apCoordinate` | AP coordinate | quantity with unit |  | units `nm`, `µm`, `mm`, `m`; default `{"unit": "mm"}` | AP position of the surface insertion point from the landmark; positive is anterior. |
| `mlCoordinate` | ML coordinate | quantity with unit |  | units `nm`, `µm`, `mm`, `m`; default `{"unit": "mm"}` | ML position of the surface insertion point from the landmark; positive is anatomical right. |
| `depth` | Insertion depth | quantity with unit |  | units `nm`, `µm`, `mm`, `m`; default `{"unit": "mm"}` | Non-negative insertion depth along the final depth axis from contact with the selected surface at the insertion point. |
| `apAngle` | AP angle | quantity with unit |  | units `°`; default `{"unit": "°"}` | First rotation: sagittal tilt from vertical around the ML axis; positive tilts anteriorly. |
| `mlAngle` | ML angle | quantity with unit |  | units `°`; default `{"unit": "°"}` | Second rotation: coronal tilt from vertical around the AP axis, after the AP tilt; positive tilts to anatomical right. |
| `rotation` | Rotation | quantity with unit |  | units `°`; default `{"unit": "°"}` | Clockwise rotation around the object's depth axis when viewed from above; 0° aligns the major feature defined for the selected anchor type with the coronal plane. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "landmarkReference": "obex",
    "landmarkDescription": "text"
}
```


## Spinal coordinates

### Spinal RC/ML/DV Absolute Coordinates

- type code `Spinal_RCMLDV_Absolute` · version 1.0.0 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Coordinates/Spinal_RCMLDV_Absolute/1.0.0.json)

Absolute spinal position from an origin on the cord central axis at a declared segment or vertebral level, with +RC rostral along the cord centerline, +ML right of midline and +DV ventral, plus RC and ML tilts and an axial rotation.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `referenceMode` | Reference mode | choice |  | one of `spinal_segment`, `vertebral_level`, `custom` | The anatomical convention anchoring the frame; vertebral references project onto the cord central axis. |
| `referenceLevel` | Reference level | text |  |  | The spinal segment or vertebral level containing the rostrocaudal origin. |
| `referenceFeature` | Reference feature | choice |  | one of `rostral_boundary`, `center`, `caudal_boundary`, `interlevel_junction`, `observed_landmark`, `custom` | The feature fixing the frame origin: the point on the cord central axis at this rostrocaudal position. |
| `referenceDescription` | Reference description | text |  |  | A concise physical definition of the custom or observed reference point in all three axes. |
| `rcCoordinate` | RC coordinate | quantity with unit |  | units `nm`, `µm`, `mm`, `m`; default `{"unit": "mm"}` | Rostral-positive position from the declared origin along the local cord centerline. |
| `rcAngle` | RC angle | quantity with unit |  | units `°`; default `{"unit": "°"}` | First approach rotation around ML; 0° follows the depth axis and positive tilts rostrally. |
| `mlCoordinate` | ML coordinate | quantity with unit |  | units `nm`, `µm`, `mm`, `m`; default `{"unit": "mm"}` | Right-positive position from the spinal cord midline. |
| `mlAngle` | ML angle | quantity with unit |  | units `°`; default `{"unit": "°"}` | Second approach rotation around RC after RC tilt; positive tilts to anatomical right. |
| `dvCoordinate` | DV coordinate | quantity with unit |  | units `nm`, `µm`, `mm`, `m`; default `{"unit": "mm"}` | Ventral-positive absolute position from the cord central axis at the declared origin. |
| `rotation` | Rotation | quantity with unit |  | units `°`; default `{"unit": "°"}` | Clockwise rotation around the object's depth axis when viewed from above; 0° aligns the major feature defined for the selected anchor type with the coronal plane. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "referenceMode": "spinal_segment",
    "referenceLevel": "text"
}
```


### Spinal RC/ML Surface Coordinates with Depth

- type code `Spinal_RCML_SurfaceDepth` · version 1.0.0 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Coordinates/Spinal_RCML_SurfaceDepth/1.0.0.json)

Spinal insertion point given as RC/ML from a declared segment or vertebral reference (+RC rostral, +ML right of midline) plus a non-negative insertion depth from a declared surface. Use it for spinal injections or electrode insertions with depth measured from the contacted surface.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `referenceMode` | Reference mode | choice |  | one of `spinal_segment`, `vertebral_level`, `custom` | The anatomical convention used to anchor the spinal frame. |
| `referenceLevel` | Reference level | text |  |  | The spinal segment or vertebral level containing the rostrocaudal origin. |
| `referenceFeature` | Reference feature | choice |  | one of `rostral_boundary`, `center`, `caudal_boundary`, `interlevel_junction`, `observed_landmark`, `custom` | The exact feature within or between levels that defines rostrocaudal zero. |
| `referenceDescription` | Reference description | text |  |  | A concise physical definition of a custom or observed spinal reference. |
| `surfaceReference` | Depth reference surface | choice |  | one of `dura_surface`, `pia_surface`, `cord_surface`, `custom` | Physical interface at the insertion point from which insertion depth begins. |
| `surfaceReferenceDescription` | Surface reference description | text |  |  | A concise physical definition of a custom depth-reference surface. |
| `rcCoordinate` | RC insertion coordinate | quantity with unit |  | units `nm`, `µm`, `mm`, `m`; default `{"unit": "mm"}` | Rostral-positive insertion-point position from the declared origin along the local cord centerline. |
| `rcAngle` | RC angle | quantity with unit |  | units `°`; default `{"unit": "°"}` | First approach rotation around ML; 0° follows the depth axis and positive tilts rostrally. |
| `mlCoordinate` | ML insertion coordinate | quantity with unit |  | units `nm`, `µm`, `mm`, `m`; default `{"unit": "mm"}` | Right-positive insertion-point position from the spinal cord midline. |
| `mlAngle` | ML angle | quantity with unit |  | units `°`; default `{"unit": "°"}` | Second approach rotation around RC after RC tilt; positive tilts to anatomical right. |
| `depth` | Insertion depth | quantity with unit |  | units `nm`, `µm`, `mm`, `m`; default `{"unit": "µm"}` | Non-negative insertion depth along the final depth axis from contact with the selected surface at the insertion point. |
| `rotation` | Rotation | quantity with unit |  | units `°`; default `{"unit": "°"}` | Clockwise rotation around the object's depth axis when viewed from above; 0° aligns the major feature defined for the selected anchor type with the coronal plane. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "referenceMode": "spinal_segment",
    "referenceLevel": "text"
}
```


## Standardized reference spaces

### Brain/MINDS Marmoset Atlas 2.0 XYZ Absolute Coordinates

- type code `BMA_XYZ_Absolute` · version 1.0.0 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Coordinates/BMA_XYZ_Absolute/1.0.0.json)

Absolute position in Brain/MINDS Marmoset Atlas 2.0 space, measured from the atlas origin between the commissures (not ear bar zero), with +X anatomical right, +Y anterior and +Z superior, plus AP and ML tilts and an axial roll. Use it for marmoset targets.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `x` | X coordinate | quantity with unit |  | units `nm`, `µm`, `mm`, `m`; default `{"unit": "mm"}` | Physical distance from the BMA 2.0 atlas origin (between the commissures, not ear bar zero); positive X is anatomical right. |
| `y` | Y coordinate | quantity with unit |  | units `nm`, `µm`, `mm`, `m`; default `{"unit": "mm"}` | Physical distance from the BMA 2.0 atlas origin (between the commissures, not ear bar zero); positive Y is anterior. |
| `z` | Z coordinate | quantity with unit |  | units `nm`, `µm`, `mm`, `m`; default `{"unit": "mm"}` | Physical distance from the BMA 2.0 atlas origin (between the commissures, not ear bar zero); positive Z is superior. |
| `apAngle` | AP angle | quantity with unit |  | units `°`; default `{"unit": "°"}` | First tilt from inferior vertical; positive tilts anteriorly. |
| `mlAngle` | ML angle | quantity with unit |  | units `°`; default `{"unit": "°"}` | Second tilt after the AP tilt; positive tilts to anatomical right. |
| `rotation` | Rotation | quantity with unit |  | units `°`; default `{"unit": "°"}` | Final axial roll around the placed object's approach axis. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "x": {
        "value": 1,
        "unit": "mm"
    },
    "y": {
        "value": 1,
        "unit": "mm"
    }
}
```

## Specimen coordinates

### Specimen Surface XY Coordinates

- type code `SpecimenSurface_XY` · version 1.0.0 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Coordinates/SpecimenSurface_XY/1.0.0.json)

Two-dimensional position on a specimen surface, with a declared origin, a mapping of specimen directions to +X and +Y and a clockwise in-plane rotation. Use it for surface locations on ex-vivo specimens, such as slices or whole mounts, where depth is not needed.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `originType` | Origin | choice |  | one of `center`, `top_left`, `top_right`, `bottom_left`, `bottom_right`, `landmark`, `embedding_block_origin`, `custom` | Origin convention for the specimen-surface XY frame. |
| `originDescription` | Origin description | text |  |  | Define the physical point and axes for a landmark or custom origin. |
| `specimenOrientation` | Specimen orientation | text |  |  | Map specimen anatomical or preparation directions to positive X and Y. |
| `x` | X coordinate | quantity with unit |  | units `nm`, `µm`, `mm`, `m`; default `{"unit": "mm"}` | Physical X position on the declared specimen surface. |
| `y` | Y coordinate | quantity with unit |  | units `nm`, `µm`, `mm`, `m`; default `{"unit": "mm"}` | Physical Y position on the declared specimen surface. |
| `rotation` | In-plane rotation | quantity with unit |  | units `°`; default `{"unit": "°"}` | Clockwise viewed toward the surface; 0° aligns the anchor major feature with +Y. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "originType": "center",
    "originDescription": "text"
}
```
